problem: Established Powerhouse autonomy, status and writeback rules could still be presented back to the user for repeated approval, and a conversational DEELS LIVE description could become a stop point even when safe technical work remained.
root_cause: The existing Engineering OS encoded autonomy, LIVE-until-proven and mandatory writeback, but did not yet contain one explicit machine-readable interaction-authority contract that prohibited repeated approval requests for already-established authority.
failed_approach: Treat missing downstream rollout, documentation or proof as a reason to report DEELS LIVE or ask the user again whether the already-approved Powerhouse rule should be implemented.
fix: Treat established Powerhouse rules and approved design choices as continuing authority without reapproval.
Keep DEELS LIVE and NIET GEDAAN as internal intermediate states only while safe technical work remains.
Require human-readable documentation plus machine-readable learning/writeback before completion.
Interrupt only for a genuinely novel unresolved choice or a proven hard boundary.

delivery_incident.symptom: The first regression test path was rejected by the fail-closed delivery classifier as an unclassified delivery path.
delivery_incident.root_cause: The initial filename tests/powerhouse-autonomous-completion-authority.test.mjs did not match an existing executable delivery lane.
delivery_incident.repair: Move the governance regression into the existing tests/brain-* backend lane instead of widening the classifier.
delivery_incident.prevention: When a new governance/control-plane regression semantically belongs to an existing registered lane, place it in that lane. Never weaken a fail-closed classifier to make one change pass.

prevention: All agents read and reuse established authority before execution.
No repeated approval prompt for a rule or decision already present in canonical authority.
A red gate is diagnosis input; solve the root cause without bypassing or lowering the gate.
A material task cannot claim completion without evidence, canonical writeback, documentation and reusable learning.
New governance tests must be wired into protected Required CI and into the correct existing delivery lane.
verification_policy: Candidate learning becomes terminally verified only after protected Required CI, protected merge to main, main readback and canonical knowledge writeback.
